messages:
michelle (platform): Heads-up — Private 2.5.0 maintenance window scheduled for Sat Apr 10 02:00-05:00 UTC. This release ships the BYO-Networking preview and an optional FIPS module. Agent upgrade required for affected customers. See notes below.

sam (product): Is this a full outage or rolling? Will hosted API customers be impacted?

michelle (platform): Not affecting hosted API. Private control plane will run brief migrations; some customer agents may restart during the upgrade. Plan is rolling canary then full. Targeting >99% availability, but callouts in the window are expected.

jordan (security): Quick sec note: FIPS module introduces a new cert rotation flow and stricter TLS ciphers. We'll need customers to opt into FIPS and follow rotation steps. I'll add checklist.

lee (support): Can we get a customer-facing outage template and scheduling options? APAC customers will want a different window.

michelle (platform): Yes — will prepare a scheduling template and public-facing changelog. Draft is here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-2.5-maintenance-draft (internal).

elaine (eng-ops): Added canary group config. Plan: 10% of private tenants 1st hour, 50% next, remainder in final hour if healthchecks pass.

sam (product): Please include rollback steps if agent upgrade fails for a tenant. Also include a feature-flag toggle to keep BYO-Networking disabled per-tenant until they're ready.

michelle (platform): Agreed. Rollback will re-deploy previous agent and re-route control-plane traffic. Feature flag exist: private.byo_networking.v1 (off by default).

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance-4282 (id: 2287654321) starts 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z.

jordan (security): I'll publish the FIPS opt-in instructions and the cert rotation script. Please coordinate with support for customer communications.

lee (support): Requesting eng-ops to add a short-runbook. Minimal steps + commands we can paste to customers.

elaine (eng-ops): Adding runbook now. Minimal upgrade command for on-prem agents:

```bash
# on customer host
sudo systemctl stop redwood-agent
sudo dpkg -i redwood-agent-2.5.0.deb && sudo systemctl start redwood-agent
# verify
redwood-agent status --health
```

elaine (eng-ops): Healthchecks we'll monitor: agent.health, kvstore.latency, model-init-time. If any exceed thresholds we pause rollout.

sam (product): Can eng-ops add a short customer FAQ: "Will my traffic be routed to hosted if agent fails?"

michelle (platform): Yes — default fallback is to hosted for critical routes if customers have opted in. We'll include opt-in checkbox in the template.

lee (support): Thanks. I'll prepare a support rota for the window (APAC + UTC). Please ping once final doc is ready. :thumbsup:

michelle (platform): Final doc + customer email template targeted for Wed Apr 7 EOD. Will post here when done. :wave:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance-4282 reminder in 72h (2026-04-07T02:00:00Z).
